findings.title: Package integrity checks must not be confused with publisher authentication
expected_behavior: A synthetic package with matching hashes but an invalid publisher signature must be rejected. Modified manifests and unauthorized signing identities must also be rejected.
findings.changes: Independent Ed25519 metadata and pinned Windows Authenticode certificate checks gate installation. Publisher pins are deliberately empty; legacy unsigned metadata cannot authorize installation. Packaging forces signing and publication gate requires authenticated metadata.
findings.evidence_status: Fixture reproduced; source-confirmed wiring; full TypeScript and standalone server build passed. No physical Windows/device/provider execution.
findings.still_needed: Provision an independently reviewed publisher public key and installer signer thumbprint, sign a schema-v2 manifest plus installer on the release pipeline, then run Windows signature/update acceptance. Do not promote current unsigned build 9 by changing trust rules.

findings.title: Desktop updates need data-conscious download controls
